$comment: Switch — a binary control that takes effect immediately (dark mode, a preference), as opposed to a checkbox, which stages a value until something is submitted. Off is the paper fill every secondary control uses; on is the brand. The thumb inverts with it, so the two states differ in fill AND in which end carries the weight — never colour alone.

border-width.comment: the sticker edge — a switch is a control, so it carries the same outline as a button

thumb-bg.comment: ink knob on the paper track

thumb-bg-checked.comment: and the inverse on the brand track

icon-color.comment: the glyph sits ON the thumb, so it takes the track's fill

gap.comment: 8px between the switch and an adjacent label
